children: Autodesk completed a $1.0 billion public offering of senior notes, issuing $500 million of 5.050% notes due 2029 and $500 million of 5.650% notes due 2033. The company plans to use the net proceeds, together with cash on hand, to repay $1.0 billion under its June 2026 term loan, supporting balance sheet flexibility. The offering was executed under an Underwriting Agreement led by Morgan Stanley & Co., BNP Paribas Securities, and Citigroup Global Markets, and the notes are governed by a Seventh Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee, featuring customary covenants, redemption options, and change-of-control protections.
